handoff_instructions: M3-T00 done. Added normalizeToE164 (packages/domain/src/phone.ts), returning { e164: "+1XXXXXXXXXX", extension } or null, alongside the pre-existing bare-digits normalizePhoneNumber (kept unchanged; still used by M2 caller-matching, not touched). Handles US formats (plain, dashed, dotted, parenthesized, with/without leading 1 or +1), trailing extensions ("ext. 123", "extension 123", "x9"), and rejects junk/wrong-length input and NANP-reserved area/exchange codes (leading 0 or 1). Exported via packages/domain/src/index.ts (already re-exports ./phone). New tests: packages/domain/test/phone.test.ts (5 cases: plain formats, country-code formats, extensions, junk input, NANP-reserved codes). No other files touched. Pure utility, no persistence/RLS/auth surface, no secrets. pnpm lint / typecheck / test all pass repo-wide (domain: 31 tests incl. 5 new). Next: M3-T01 "Employee phone identity lookup" — a service resolving an inbound phone number (via this new normalizeToE164) to exactly one active employee within one organization, with an ops case on ambiguous/unknown numbers.
